limitations: Static preview only, not live VRCX-0 or BaseUI runtime.
Computed solid colors plus conservative checked-thumb gradient endpoint, not all image pixel contrast.
No portal stacking, virtual lists, actual desktop window controls, DPI/zoom or OS scrollbars tested.
Disabled contrast follows app opacity and is WCAG-exempt.
teamChanges: Checked thumb dark faceted gradient preserves >=3:1 boundary on pink track.
Sidebar hover excludes data-disabled and aria-disabled.

liveUiVerification.method: Real VRCX-0 frontend served by `npm run dev` (Vite, http://localhost:9000) loaded in headless Chromium; each theme injected into a freshly loaded page. Contrast from canvas-sampled sRGB pixels: foreground over its own fill, then over the page background at the element's effective opacity chain (0.5 for disabled controls).
liveUiVerification.result: No change needed. Disabled checked checkbox and disabled primary button both measure 3.18:1, level with the unstyled app baseline of 3.32:1.
liveUiVerification.methodologyCorrection: An earlier run reported about 1.1:1 for this theme. That was an artefact of injecting two theme files into one page; with one theme per freshly loaded page the ratio is 3.18:1. VRCX-0 installs a single theme snapshot, so the stacked scenario does not occur.
liveUiVerification.noteOnDisabled: WCAG exempts inactive components; the numbers are reported only for comparison against the unstyled app.
limits: Real frontend has no Tauri backend
